detail: General Updates - Share India Securities Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company on September 07, 2026, has received a certified true copy of the Order of the Hon ble NCLT, Ahmedabad Bench   I, approving the Scheme of Amalgamation of Silverleaf Capital Services Private Limited with Share India Securities Limited.
